sentences.en: The shopping arcade was covered with lots of paper decorations.
sentences.zh: 这家购物拱廊挂满了各种纸制装饰。

sentences.en: We should go to the arcade sometime.
sentences.zh: 我们有空可以去那条有拱廊的街道走走。

sentences.en: Real-time strategy games usually involve arcade elements.
sentences.zh: 即时战略游戏通常包含街机元素。

senses.zh: [建]拱廊；有拱廊的街道；（内设投角子电子游戏机等的）游乐场
